name: ClearView (Unified) Renderer
definition: A 3-pass WebGL2 renderer using Parallel Prefix List (PPLL) for unstructured mesh rendering, consisting of Clear, Gather, and Resolve passes.
summary: ClearView (Unified) Renderer is a WebGL2 method for real-time hexahedral mesh visualization that avoids server-side SSBOs by encoding geometry into textures and performing all sorting and compositing on the GPU.
